in_sanskrit.name: Binodini
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon-like, Auspicious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Binodini एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Binodini is derived from the Sanskrit words 'bina' (moon) and 'din' (day or auspicious). In Hindu mythology, the moon is considered a feminine deity and represents fertility, nourishment, and calmness. The name Binodini signifies a woman who embodies these divine qualities and brings prosperity and happiness in her wake.

in_hindi.long_meaning: Bringer of Joy and Pleasure for Women
